notes.what: 0.14.8601 (2026-10-03) is the newest published Windows build. The project's NEWS records the security fixes it carries, which the tagged 0.14 build predates; the pack pins a version with them rather than the older tag.
notes.quote:
* Fixed CVE-2026-63474 (GHSA-qg2f-8389-w95j, Moderate): heap-buffer-overflow
    WRITE in decompress_R2004_section, bypassing an earlier fix.
    read_2004_compressed_section reset dec.size to a smaller per-section
    value inside its loop, so bit_chain_alloc could shrink the live
    decompression buffer while dec.byte/sec_dat->size kept tracking the
    larger logical stream.  Reported by yPin9.
